response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with strong web/full-stack, D-language, and distributed-systems background, but his career has been overwhelmingly focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and web platforms rather than C++. His only substantial C++ experience is a brief 6-month stint in 2014-2015 and a bachelor thesis project, with no evidence of recent C++/STL architecture work, IEC 62443 security standards, MQTT, or industrial automation protocols required for this role.
strengths: Extensive senior/staff-level engineering experience (15+ years) across many domains
Strong systems-level background (low-latency, async I/O, multi-threading in DLang) transferable to C++ concepts
Demonstrated architecture, mentoring, workshop-teaching, and open-source leadership skills
concerns: C++ experience is minimal and outdated (only ~6 months, a decade ago), not matching 8-12 years C++-focused requirement
No evidence of IEC 62443, SDL, or industrial cybersecurity experience
No mention of MQTT, industrial protocols (Modbus, OPC UA, IEC 61850/104, DNP3) or IoT/automation domain work

key_factors.factor: Strong general senior engineering and systems skills
